This fixture is committed to the agentic-rag repository for UAT purposes
(Phase 071.1 D-071.1-05). It is not used by any binding pytest — see
academic_synth.{pdf,docx} for the CI regression net.

Modifications:
  - friendly_real.pdf: byte-identical to the arXiv-distributed PDF (no changes).
  - friendly_real.docx: NOT distributed by the authors. Generated for fixture
    purposes by extracting text + tables from the PDF via Docling
    (docling==2.93.0) and rendering into DOCX via python-docx. Contains the
    same logical content (text + 4 tables) but figures and layout differ from
    the original PDF. This sibling DOCX is for friendly-fixture UAT only and
    is not represented as the authors' Word version.

Date committed: 2026-05-15

Fixture variance note:
  - PDF: 9 pages, real text layer, 4 tables (Docling-detected), 1 image.
    Within the 8-12 page window required by D-071.1-05.
  - The "≥2 figures" criterion is not met (1 figure in the PDF, 0 embedded in
    the generated DOCX). This is an informational gate for friendly UAT, not
    binding. The thesis SC#1 retry on 23cc112a / 911225a6 remains the binding
    gate per D-071.1-06.
